senses.gloss: m. (חצי) carpenter’s adze, also pick-axe or spade (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Dolabra).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 44:12">Targ. Is. XLIV, 12</cite> (h. text <cite ref="M02159"><he>מעצד</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:5">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>נפל ליה ח׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <cite ref="H01525"><he>חציצא</he></cite>) a carpenter lost his adze there.
<cite ref="Eruvin 77b">Erub. 77ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02480"><he>מָרָא</he> II</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>חֲצִינֵי</he>.
B. Kam. 119ᵇ באתרא … תרי ח׳ וכ׳ in the place of our Tanna (in the Mishnah) there are two ḥătsiné a large one called כשיל (axe), and a small one called מעצד (adze).
